_note: Scaffold of rive-app/rive-runtime as read 2026-10-14 via gh + npm + README. Nothing installed.
description: Low-level C++ Rive runtime and renderer
versioning: no GitHub releases (releases/latest 404); consumed through language runtimes
what_this_repo_is: The C++ core: loads .riv files, advances state machines/animations, draws through an abstract Renderer; built-in GPU renderer targets Metal, Vulkan, D3D11/12, OpenGL/WebGL. Apple, Android, Flutter, Unity, Unreal and web runtimes all wrap it.
IMPORTANT: This repo is NOT installed into a JS app. You build C++ from it only to embed natively (needs clang, premake5, platform SDK). The web runtime that wraps it is a separate npm family.

@rive-app/canvas-single.note: wasm inlined in the JS, single file

@rive-app/react-webgl2.note: React wrapper over the WebGL2 runtime

web_runtime_npm_family.caveat: Sizes are unpacked dist sizes from npm view, including the wasm payload; transfer size is smaller and was not measured

asset_dependency.format: .riv files authored in the Rive editor
asset_dependency.status: NONE exist in this repo for SkyyRose; a runtime without .riv assets renders nothing
asset_dependency.owner: founder / design; authoring is a separate paid-tool workflow

surfaces: theme via @rive-app/canvas (vanilla; wasm must be self-hosted, no CDN per theme rule)
plausible_uses: interactive UI micro-animations driven by state machines (size selector, add-to-bag, toggles)
mascot-like characters; NOTE the mascot is a GLB (v6) and its behaviour is founder-locked, do not replace
skyyrose_fit.overlap: Motion already handles UI transitions; Rive adds designer-authored state-machine animation with a visual editor
brand_constraints: Self-host wasm and .riv files (zero-CDN theme rule)
Any character or logo animation must match the canonical reference; QC against real asset, not a description

gaps: Transfer size and wasm self-hosting path untested
Whether Rive is wanted over Motion is a founder call
